Protests Erupt Against 'SIR' Process, Allegations of Bias Emerge

Protests have been organized against a process referred to as 'SIR', with allegations that it is anti-democratic and disproportionately affects marginalized voters, particularly Muslims. The TVK party has criticized the SIR process, calling it biased. The TPCC chief stated that the Congress party plans to mobilize 200,000 people for an anti-SIR rally. One report noted that a protest organized by INDIA bloc parties in Chennai lacked party flags or visible cadres, despite media claims of participation.
